description: Source code for a positioning measurement procedure in a 3GPP-related telecommunications system, including functions for mapping RSRP values, handling measurement requests, and preparing responses.

classes.name: positioning_measurement_procedure
classes.description: Class implementing the positioning measurement procedure, including request handling and response preparation.

methods.name: rsrp_dbfs_to_l3_rsrp_mapping
methods.description: Maps RSRP in dBFS to L3 RSRP value according to TS 38.133.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main operator to execute the measurement procedure, handling MAC request and preparing response.

methods.name: handle_mac_meas_request
methods.description: Handles the MAC measurement request asynchronously.

methods.name: prepare_f1ap_response
methods.description: Prepares the F1AP response with measurement results.

methods.name: srs_config_matches
methods.description: Checks if two SRS configurations match.

methods.name: prepare_mac_cell_positioning_request
methods.description: Prepares MAC cell positioning request based on cell index and carrier configuration.
